cd /app && python3 - <<'EOF'
import grpc
import kv_store_pb2
import kv_store_pb2_grpc

channel = grpc.insecure_channel("localhost:5328")
grpc.channel_ready_future(channel).result(timeout=10)
stub = kv_store_pb2_grpc.KVStoreStub(channel)

# Set a value
r = stub.SetVal(kv_store_pb2.SetValRequest(key="foo", value=42))
print("SetVal(foo, 42) ->", r.val)

# Get it back
r = stub.GetVal(kv_store_pb2.GetValRequest(key="foo"))
print("GetVal(foo) ->", r.val)

# Another key
r = stub.SetVal(kv_store_pb2.SetValRequest(key="bar", value=-7))
print("SetVal(bar, -7) ->", r.val)
r = stub.GetVal(kv_store_pb2.GetValRequest(key="bar"))
print("GetVal(bar) ->", r.val)

# Missing key -> default 0
r = stub.GetVal(kv_store_pb2.GetValRequest(key="missing"))
print("GetVal(missing) ->", r.val)
EOF
